canonical_project: Konza Data Centre Cloud and Smart City Facilities Expansion
owner: Konza Technopolis Development Authority (KoTDA); PPP investor to be selected
notes: Business Daily reported on 2026-01-28 that Kenya's PPP Directorate approved the Konza Data Centre Cloud and Smart City Facilities Expansion proposal to feasibility stage, covering expansion of server infrastructure, cloud capacity, backup, videoconferencing, colocation, and web hosting. Included under Kajiado due to Konza's cross-county planning/buffer footprint, while noting the article caption describes phase 2 data centre at Konza Technopolis in Machakos County. No public MW capacity found.
